customManagers.description: OpenTofu and TFLint in .prototools, whose plugins are lattice's own, so Renovate's proto manager doesn't know them (stackr ADR-0029).
The images stackr's AWS modules name in their variables' defaults, by tag and digest.
The BuildKit that deploy/image-archive builds a stackr release's images with, by tag and digest (stackr ADR-0035).

packageRules.description: Python ranges stay as written: the lockfile moves, and the packages' floors move by hand, with the code that needs them.
A release waits three days, on PyPI as on npm.
PostgreSQL stays at major 17, the version local Supabase runs.
proto, which every CI job installs, waits three days too; its digests in .github/actions/toolchain/proto.sha256 move by hand (lattice ADR-0017).
Bun's version is in .prototools and in package.json's packageManager field: they move together, after the same three days.
TanStack Router's runtime, its Vite plugin and its generator write and read one route tree: they move together.
ui's Playwright and app's @playwright/test drive one Chromium: they move together.
json-schema-to-typescript 16 needs js-yaml 5, and the root's overrides hold js-yaml at 4.3.2 for the Bruno CLI (portalr ADR-0010).
client's typescript is TypeScript 6, which openapi-typescript loads, until it supports TypeScript 7's API (portalr ADR-0007).
The template's files are Jinja, which Renovate can't parse; the template's pins move by hand, as its generated applications' Renovate moves theirs.
Langfuse's web and worker are pinned to the same exact version and move together (stackr ADR-0008).
Chainguard rebuilds MinIO's only free tag, latest, every day; its digest moves once a month (stackr ADR-0008).
